canonical_title: Neural Relational Inference for Interacting Systems

annotation.why: Infers latent interaction graphs from trajectories with a graph-based dynamics decoder.
annotation.focus: The latent graph, the graph-based dynamics decoder, and whether relation recovery agrees with predictive performance.
annotation.boundary: Recovering relations from observations does not establish causal identification under arbitrary conditions.

canonical_title: Contrastive Learning of Structured World Models

annotation.why: Learns object-centric representations and relational dynamics with a contrastive objective.
annotation.focus: The distinct roles of object representations, relational dynamics, and the contrastive objective.
annotation.boundary: Success on structured benchmarks does not establish open-world compositional generalization.

canonical_title: SPARTAN: A Sparse Transformer World Model Attending to What Matters

annotation.why: Uses sparse, context-dependent interactions to adapt to changes in mechanisms.
annotation.focus: Sparse attention, intervention settings, few-shot adaptation, and the priors available to the model.
annotation.boundary: Interpret generalization results in the context of sparse mechanism changes and object-centric assumptions.

canonical_title: Causal-JEPA: Learning World Models through Object-Level Latent Masking

annotation.why: Combines object-level latent masking with joint-embedding predictive learning.
annotation.focus: How object-level latent masking creates structured partial observability and affects the use of relational information.
annotation.boundary: Latent masking is not automatically an intervention on a real physical causal mechanism.

canonical_title: Interpreting Physics in Video World Models

annotation.why: Analyzes the organization of physical information through layer-wise probes, subspaces, and interventions.
annotation.focus: Layer-wise differences in speed and direction; circular population codes; what probes, attention ablations, and directional steering each establish.
annotation.boundary: Changing a decoded direction does not establish improved native prediction or planning. Linear subspace dimension and intrinsic manifold dimension are different quantities.

canonical_title: Hypothesis-Driven Feature Manifold Analysis in LLMs via Supervised Multi-Dimensional Scaling
aliases: Shape Happens: Automatic Feature Manifold Discovery in LLMs via Supervised Multi-Dimensional Scaling

annotation.why: Compares geometric hypotheses and their functional effects in language-model representations.
annotation.focus: How SMDS uses supervision to compare circular, linear, and clustered hypotheses; held-out evaluation and intervention evidence.
annotation.boundary: This is supervised, hypothesis-driven analysis, not discovery without priors. Its LLM results are not established findings about world models.

canonical_title: Cloning Deterministic Worlds: The Critical Role of Latent Geometry in Long-Horizon World Models
aliases: Clone Deterministic 3D Worlds with Geometrically-Regularized World Models

annotation.why: Connects representation geometry and temporal context to long-horizon prediction error.
annotation.focus: Ground-truth state oracle comparisons, temporal-context encoders, slowness and uniformity regularization, and the corresponding ablations.
annotation.boundary: The main evidence concerns deterministic environments with fixed rules. Separate geometric regularization from history-based disambiguation; neither establishes general open-world robustness.

canonical_title: Learning Abstract World Models with a Group-Structured Latent Space

annotation.why: Encodes known symmetries, such as translation and rotation, as geometric inductive biases.
annotation.focus: How group actions correspond to latent transitions and how structured and unstructured information coexist.
annotation.boundary: Using known symmetries is different from discovering physical laws from data.

canonical_title: The Origins of Representation Manifolds in Large Language Models

annotation.why: Relates similarities in learned representations to intrinsic conceptual geometry under a generative model.
annotation.focus: The generative assumptions, the relation between cosine similarity and intrinsic geometry, and testable predictions.
annotation.boundary: The results rely on explicit assumptions about text representations; they are not universal laws for arbitrary networks or world models.

canonical_title: GeoWorld: Geometric World Models

annotation.why: Studies non-Euclidean latent spaces and geometric optimization for procedural visual planning.
annotation.focus: The separate contributions of Hyperbolic JEPA and geometric optimization, including matched Euclidean comparisons.
annotation.boundary: The main tasks are multi-step procedural visual planning on CrossTask and COIN, rather than continuous physical dynamics or demonstrated real-robot transfer.

canonical_title: Context-aware Dynamics Model for Generalization in Model-Based Reinforcement Learning

annotation.why: Infers environment context from interaction history to model changing dynamics.
annotation.focus: History encoding, forward and backward prediction objectives, and the training and test dynamics distributions.
annotation.boundary: Useful context representations alone do not demonstrate learning new laws. Distinguish hidden-parameter inference from directly supplied parameters.

canonical_title: Context and Diversity Matter: The Emergence of In-Context Learning in World Models

annotation.why: Distinguishes recognizing familiar environments from learning dynamics through current experience.
annotation.focus: Definitions and assumptions behind environment recognition and environment learning; environment diversity, context length, and controls for familiar-environment matching.
annotation.boundary: The framework is not an exhaustive classification of all neural algorithms. State estimation and memory may also explain improvements.

canonical_title: Dreamweaver: Learning Compositional World Models from Pixels

annotation.why: Learns object and attribute representations for combinations beyond training configurations.
annotation.focus: Which factors are decomposed and how unseen combinations are defined in training and evaluation.
annotation.boundary: Generating unseen combinations does not by itself establish closed-loop planning, adaptation to unknown physical mechanisms, or real-world transfer.

canonical_title: Dynamics Are Learned, Not Told: Semi-Supervised Discovery of Latent Dynamics Geometries For Zero-Shot Policy Adaptation

annotation.why: Connects trajectory geometry with policy adaptation under changing dynamics.
annotation.focus: Trajectory dynamics encoders, Lipschitz assumptions, multi-positive contrastive learning, and tests of unmodeled dynamics changes.
annotation.boundary: This work studies reinforcement-learning policy adaptation; its theory is not automatically a theorem about general video world models.

canonical_title: DINO-WM: World Models on Pre-trained Visual Features enable Zero-shot Planning

annotation.why: Combines frozen visual representations, action-conditioned latent prediction, and goal-directed planning.
annotation.focus: The frozen visual encoder, action-conditioned patch prediction, and the planning objective in goal space.
annotation.boundary: Zero-shot planning still relies on dynamics training with trajectories from the relevant domain.

canonical_title: Denoised MDPs: Learning World Models Better Than the World Itself

annotation.why: Separates controllable and reward-relevant information from other factors in observations.
annotation.focus: The decomposition by controllability and reward relevance, and its effect on learning.
annotation.boundary: Information irrelevant to the current task may matter for another task. The decomposition relies on structural assumptions.

canonical_title: The Value Equivalence Principle for Model-Based Reinforcement Learning

annotation.why: Formalizes models that preserve decision-relevant Bellman updates without reconstructing every world detail.
annotation.focus: The policy and value-function classes over which Bellman updates remain equivalent.
annotation.boundary: Equivalence is relative to specified function and policy classes; it does not guarantee suitability for arbitrary future tasks.

canonical_title: What Has a Foundation Model Found? Using Inductive Bias to Probe for World Models

annotation.why: Probes learned world structure through inductive biases in new tasks.
annotation.focus: How hypothesized world models generate diagnostic tasks and how learning behavior reveals inductive bias.
annotation.boundary: The probe measures inductive bias, rather than ordinary linear decodability. Conclusions remain tied to the tested tasks and hypotheses.

canonical_title: Evaluating Real-World Robot Manipulation Policies in Simulation

annotation.why: Evaluates whether simulation reliably predicts the relative performance of real-world manipulation policies.
annotation.focus: Paired real and simulated evaluations, policy rankings, visual matching, and variant aggregation.
annotation.boundary: Perturbations within simulation alone do not demonstrate a reduced reality gap.

canonical_title: Rethinking Sim2Real: Lower Fidelity Simulation Leads to Higher Sim2Real Transfer in Navigation

annotation.why: Examines how simulation fidelity affects transfer in visual navigation.
annotation.focus: Which navigation simulation details are changed and how they affect transfer.
annotation.boundary: The findings concern the navigation settings studied; they do not imply that lower fidelity is always preferable.

canonical_title: How Far Is Video Generation from World Model: A Physical Law Perspective

annotation.why: Tests physical prediction under extrapolation and compositional distribution shifts.
annotation.focus: How distribution shifts are constructed and whether visual-quality metrics obscure physical successes or failures.
annotation.boundary: The findings concern the tested models and datasets, rather than universal limitations of all video models.

canonical_title: World-In-World: World Models in a Closed-Loop World

annotation.why: Evaluates world models through closed-loop task performance.
annotation.focus: How action controllability, post-training data, and test-time computation affect closed-loop performance.
annotation.boundary: Closed-loop evaluations still have task-coverage limits. Scaling claims should remain tied to the evaluated settings.

canonical_title: Planning to Explore via Self-Supervised World Models

annotation.why: Learns exploration behavior from model disagreement before downstream tasks are specified.
annotation.focus: Model disagreement, predictive novelty, and subsequent task learning.
annotation.boundary: General novelty does not necessarily identify the information most valuable for a particular task.

canonical_title: ASID: Active Exploration for System Identification in Robotic Manipulation

annotation.why: Combines active interaction with system identification to improve simulation models.
annotation.focus: How informative actions are chosen and how identified quantities enter the subsequent model.
annotation.boundary: Estimating parameters within a given model class differs from discovering missing mechanisms.

canonical_title: Poke and Strike: Learning Task-Informed Exploration Policies

annotation.why: Selects exploratory interactions according to task-relevant information.
annotation.focus: Task sensitivity, exploration rewards, stopping criteria, and privileged information available during training.
annotation.boundary: The method uses privileged information during training; evaluation should distinguish training access from information available to the deployed policy.

canonical_title: Curious Replay for Model-based Adaptation

annotation.why: Prioritizes stored experience using novelty and prediction error to support adaptation.
annotation.focus: The roles of novelty, prediction error, and replay prioritization.
annotation.boundary: Replaying stored experience differs from actively choosing new physical interactions.

canonical_title: V-JEPA 2: Self-Supervised Video Models Enable Understanding, Prediction and Planning

annotation.why: Connects observational video pretraining with action-conditioned prediction and planning.
annotation.focus: What passive pretraining and action-conditioned post-training each learn, and the interfaces used in evaluation.
annotation.boundary: Representation pretraining alone is not a complete planning system. The action interface requires relevant interaction data.

canonical_title: LeWorldModel: Stable End-to-End Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture from Pixels

annotation.why: Learns a compact world model end to end with joint-embedding predictive objectives.
annotation.focus: The predictive loss, latent-distribution regularization, planning interface, and physical probes.
annotation.boundary: The reported model has about 15M parameters. Training-time figures depend on the hardware, dataset, and optimization setup.

canonical_title: What Drives Success in Physical Planning with Joint-Embedding Predictive World Models?

annotation.why: Compares architecture, training objectives, and planners in JEPA world models.
annotation.focus: Matched comparisons of architectures, training objectives, planning algorithms, and data scale.
annotation.boundary: The findings concern the evaluated JEPA world-model family, not every type of world model.

canonical_title: Mastering diverse control tasks through world models

annotation.why: Studies a shared world-model learning algorithm and hyperparameters across diverse tasks.
annotation.focus: Which hyperparameters and algorithmic choices are shared, and which model parameters are trained per environment.
annotation.boundary: A shared algorithm and hyperparameters do not imply a single pretrained checkpoint that generalizes everywhere without training.
